rows.label: the four kinds are merged into K2D (same objects as K2D_R45), reachable through overlay.js ALL_KINDS, and the round-3 kinds are still there
layers/manifest.json lists layers.embeddingCloud, .epicycleDraw, .hexMosaic, .convergeToDot with file, tags, params, doc and this test (node make-manifests.mjs rewrites it)
cuesR45: every cue of the four layers resolves in sfx/manifest.json, has a time >= 0 and a reason (2, 1, 1, 3, 1, 0, 2, 1 cues over 8 param sets)
embeddingCloud: defaults draw at 2.2 s (922 canvas calls, finite numbers)
epicycleDraw: defaults draw at 2 s (1939 canvas calls, finite numbers)
hexMosaic: defaults draw at 0.8 s (5310 canvas calls, finite numbers)
convergeToDot: defaults draw at 1.2 s (209 canvas calls, finite numbers)
embeddingCloud: 14 param variants all change the draw and stay finite
epicycleDraw: 13 param variants all change the draw and stay finite
hexMosaic: 9 param variants all change the draw and stay finite
convergeToDot: 11 param variants all change the draw and stay finite

epicycleDraw: nothing is drawn before at (t -1 and at - 1 frame make no canvas call); it draws from at
embeddingCloud: before queryAt the frame is exactly the cloud without a query (no chip text, no neighbour lines, no lit points); 0.5 s after it the chip and lines are there
hexMosaic: before the first wave (0.3 s) all 315 tiles show face 0, full width, no flip in progress
convergeToDot: before at every node is home (k = 0, only the slow wobble moves it) and the dot has its start radius
embeddingCloud loop 6: frame t and t + 6 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
epicycleDraw loop 4: frame t and t + 4 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 6: frame t and t + 6 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 4 with a panel: frame t and t + 4 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 5 with a panel: frame t and t + 5 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 6 with a panel: frame t and t + 6 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 7 with a panel: frame t and t + 7 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
hexMosaic loop 10 with a panel: frame t and t + 10 s are identical (5 times); a third of a loop later it is a different frame
embeddingCloud without loop: it keeps rotating (frame t and t + 6 s differ)

embeddingCloud images: each thumbnail keeps its own image while the cloud turns (the same 22 draws, tally [["IMGA",8],["IMGB",7],["IMGC",7]], at 0.4 s and 3.7 s; the index is a property of the point, not of where it is on screen)
embeddingCloud images: a string source that is not decoded (no Image in node, or not loaded yet) draws the placeholder tile, exactly the frame without images
hexMosaic image faces: every tile draws an image (hundreds of drawImage calls), each tile always the same one, and the frame is identical on a repeat render
embeddingCloud with images: identical draw calls in forward and shuffled seek order (70 seeks)
preloadImages: resolves at once with nothing to load, with objects and with strings when there is no Image (node); K2D kinds list their sources in assets()

brandField URL logo: after stack.ready() the first frame already draws the logo (6 of 6 fresh logos) and the same frame is identical once any late load would have landed (6 of 6); the kind lists the source in assets()
brandField URL logo that fails to load: ready() still resolves, the placeholder mark is drawn, and it stays the same frame (never a half state)
brandField with an already decoded logo object draws it on the first frame

epicycleDraw readout: three lines (N = 64 | 64 rotating circles  ·  mean error 0.08% of size | mean distance of the drawn curve from the input path), type 22..38 px at 1080p (note >= 22, never the 14 px of before), the same px on a 1080 x 1920 frame (shorter side); an empty or null source falls back to the default note (a printed number is never unlabelled); a custom source replaces it; readout: false prints nothing
epicycleDraw readoutAt moves the readout (N line at y 938 by default, 690 at readoutAt y 0.7, so it can sit inside a 9:16 safe zone)
embeddingCloud: the 6 lit points are exactly the 6 nearest to the query vector (brute-force check on 282 points), computed once in the plan
embeddingCloud: the thumbnail count is capped at 48 (render time), however many are asked for
embeddingCloud: after the lift every neighbour sits exactly lift (0.45) closer to the camera than before and every other point is unchanged

embeddingCloud collapse: after collapseAt + spread + collapse every one of the 282 points lies on the mark outline (worst 1.1e-13 px off); with mark: your own SVG path (a triangle) they land on that outline instead (1.9e-13 px)
epicycleDraw: with all 1024 terms the chain tip passes through its 1024 path samples (worst 1.2e-10 px); the coefficients are computed once and cached
epicycleDraw N = full: the trace matches the input path at 1080p, Hausdorff bird 0.69, wave 0.56, spiral 0.64, swoop 0.56 px (< 1; closed outline sampled once, open paths traced there and back)

epicycleDraw: the mean error (distance of the drawn curve from the INPUT path, not from the DFT's own samples) falls as terms are added (N = 4, 16, 64, full: 2.23%, 0.60%, 0.08%, 0.00% of the figure size); at full it is small but not a computed 0 (7.9e-4%, printed as <0.01)
epicycleDraw steps: the term count follows the step table and every step re-traces from phase 0 (N 4 -> 16 -> 64)
epicycleDraw trail: the first trace is drawn only up to the tip (1473 segments at half a trace, 2913 once it closed); a short trail keeps 469 segments, read from the analytic curve

hexMosaic: 315 tiles on an axial hex lattice (row step 1.5 r, column step sqrt(3) r, odd rows offset half a column) and the field covers the frame (farthest of 300 random points is 62.7 px from a centre, r = 64)
hexMosaic: each tile starts to flip at wave time + distance / speed (+ at most 0.08 s of seeded jitter): 315 tiles, lag 0.000..0.083 s
hexMosaic: a wave front is a band (14 of 315 tiles mid-flip at 0.5 s) and after it every tile shows face 1 at full width
hexMosaic flip: the face changes exactly at the narrowest point of the flip (sx near 0, face switches at k 0.5)
convergeToDot: after at + stagger + dur all 24 nodes sit on the centre (0.0e+0 px off) and the dot has grown to 56 px
convergeToDot order: outside-in leaves the farthest node first (k 0.02 vs nearest 0.00 at 0.15 s); inside-out reverses it (0.00 vs 0.00)

convergeToDot: at 0.97 s after at the 23 drawn lines are exactly the 23 live edges of 24, both ends on that frame's node positions (recomputed every frame, no stored state); lines whose end reached the dot are dropped
convergeToDot reverse (one dot blooming into a network): before at only the solid dot is on screen (1 arc), after at + stagger + dur every node is back home
embeddingCloud: query + neighbours: mounted via mountStack (embeddingCloud), bit-identical at t 2.4 after rendering t 0.37
embeddingCloud: collapsed into the mark: mounted via mountStack (embeddingCloud), bit-identical at t 5.4 after rendering t 0.37
epicycleDraw: N = 4: mounted via mountStack (epicycleDraw), bit-identical at t 2.2 after rendering t 0.37
epicycleDraw: N = 64: mounted via mountStack (epicycleDraw), bit-identical at t 8.6 after rendering t 0.37
epicycleDraw: full + inset: mounted via mountStack (epicycleDraw), bit-identical at t 4.2 after rendering t 0.37
hexMosaic: wave front + panel: mounted via mountStack (hexMosaic), bit-identical at t 0.6 after rendering t 0.37
hexMosaic: engraved: mounted via mountStack (hexMosaic), bit-identical at t 2 after rendering t 0.37
convergeToDot: network: mounted via mountStack (convergeToDot), bit-identical at t 0.4 after rendering t 0.37
convergeToDot: contracting: mounted via mountStack (convergeToDot), bit-identical at t 1.3 after rendering t 0.37
embeddingCloud: pixels identical when the same 6 times are rendered again in shuffled order
epicycleDraw: pixels identical when the same 6 times are rendered again in shuffled order
hexMosaic: pixels identical when the same 6 times are rendered again in shuffled order
convergeToDot: pixels identical when the same 6 times are rendered again in shuffled order

hexMosaic image faces (real images): placeholders before the images decode (0 image-coloured pixels), the images drawn once they have (466740), identical pixels at t 1 on every repeat and after other times, 3 Image objects for 3 sources over 10 frames

embeddingCloud thumbnails (real images): placeholders before the images decode (0 image-coloured pixels), the images drawn once they have (9949), identical pixels at t 1 on every repeat and after other times, 3 Image objects for 3 sources over 10 frames
